In-house design to build

A single team from calculation to hand-over.

Derban Engineering Consultancy (ACETEC) keeps design, engineering and construction under one roof, so the drawing that is approved is the building that gets built.

We are a construction, design and engineering firm built on quality, safety and delivery on time, creating durable, cost-effective work that adds long-term value.

From ultra-modern sports courts for Giants of Africa to multi-storey apartments, hotels and residential renovations, we handle the full arc of a project. Our structural engineers set out and supervise; our architects produce drawings and 3D renders; our project managers hold the programme and budget.

The result is reliable work that meets client needs while holding to industry standards and best practice.
